human_view.title: Decision Value Calculus V2.1 — canonical decision math
human_view.essence: One shared calculus for filtering inadmissible actions, scoring admissible options, compressing ambiguity, selecting ACT / READ_MORE / ASK / REFUSE, verifying outcomes, and learning through versioned recalibration.
human_view.why: Reduce unnecessary human orchestration while increasing decision quality without allowing value scores to create authority, truth, consent, or safety exceptions.
human_view.uncertainty: Source and CI behavior are verified; universal production runtime use and production graph-mediated behavior remain pending proof.

ai_view.operating_flow: OBJECTIVE → CURRENT_TRUTH → GATES → QUALITY → CONSERVATIVE_VALUE+INTERVAL → CONFIDENCE/EVIDENCE → TOP3 → AUTHORITY → ACT|READ_MORE|ASK|REFUSE → OBSERVE → VERIFY → LEDGER → LEARN → VERSIONED_RECALIBRATION

nine_node_roles.SELF: resolve declared objective, stakeholders, baseline, horizon, and current ladder state
nine_node_roles.LAW: apply hard gates, Prime Judgment Rule, scope, consent, authority, and risk policy before optimization
nine_node_roles.ACT: execute only an ACT outcome that is admissible, authorized, bounded, and selected by the canonical calculus
nine_node_roles.KNOW: supply current evidence-bound facts, estimates, prior decision receipts, and applicable retained intelligence
nine_node_roles.PROVE: preserve scoring inputs, provenance, uncertainty, gate reasons, predicted value, and decision receipt evidence
nine_node_roles.CONNECT: retrieve and relate applicable intelligence, dependencies, affected parties, baselines, and graph context without creating truth or authority
nine_node_roles.VERIFY: independently recompute decision/outcome claims, compare predicted vs observed value, and preserve calibration error
nine_node_roles.LEARN: turn verified calibration error into versioned VALUE_RECALIBRATION learning candidates; never self-ratify
nine_node_roles.EVOLVE: promote only verified and authorized recalibration versions into successor/system continuity without changing constitutional boundaries

proof.limitation: Graph edges encode canonical semantic applicability only. They do not prove live graph traversal changes runtime behavior.

successor_effect: A cold successor can reconstruct the same decision method, recompute material decisions, and distinguish ACT, READ_MORE, ASK, and REFUSE without inheriting authority.
